adjudication.summary: Row #91 does not meet the apotheosis spec in paint, but nothing in it FALLS: every confirmed defect is mechanical, small, and curable inside the existing architecture. I re-verified every contested claim myself — running the shipped staffGeometry/glyphs under node, reading the glass-ladder sources, and inspecting the banked cells. CONFIRMED: (1) the strike is time-reversed — all 14 motif notes fire at loop fraction 1−φ while crossing the reading line at φ, zero matches, and the sole gate is symmetric in φ↔1−φ so it cannot see it; (2) the determinate ink and completion seal are written into glass-resting's own ::after/::before (grain-overlay.css names itself SOLE writer; material.css sets inset:0) — both paint at 0.025/0.07 opacity, the seal lands at the LEFT edge over the clef, and the folio loses its grain and rim in loading mode; (3) no beam touches a stem (anchored at head centres, off by stemAttachX 0.57 at both ends, sign-flipped on down-stem groups; the demo corpus emits stub j-b2 with x2<x1, violating the suite's own gated invariant); (4) winding holes in 4 of 7 glyphs — sharp and natural bars wind opposite their stems (probe: winding 0 at every crossing), the F-clef ball cancels against its body (the cell's white wedge, seen directly in 10-zoom), and the G-clef eye centre has winding 0 (paper, not ink); (5) all five public tokens are declared on .music-staff itself so ancestor overrides are dead, against spec §11 and the repo's Progress.vue idiom, with two shipped story blurbs asserting the opposite; (6) the reel runs dry above 1354 px (guaranteed ink 169.3 sp vs 229.9 sp of rules, locked in by the contract test's use-count), the empty staff is 62 px, and the engraving fills ~31% of its folio; (7) sealed ≠ stopped (strikes keep running, aria-busy persists at valuenow=1); (8) the reel streams over the parked clef with no gutter or mask. CHALLENGED BACK: Verify's open-head craft defect is REFUTED (stroke-inclusive bboxes 1.175×1.000 vs 1.175×0.992 — a superlative, not a defect), its hover-defect is overruled by spec §0's explicit rejection, and its seal-geometry-correct claim inverts (position wrong, size right); the engraving challenger's ±0.25-rise objection misquotes the spec (§4 includes ±0.25); the design challenger's §13 export defect is a spec nit (index.ts matches §13 verbatim); the use-clones-don't-animate claim is UNDER-DETERMINED from disk and moves to the Verify seat post-cure. VERIFIED SUPERLATIVE and to be preserved: Bravura-exact METRICS, spell() as single spelling authority, ledger containment and auto-clef proven over the full range, working ink-clearance spacing, per-mode ARIA, token-named spring motion, and the zero-JS reel — which is one sign away from correct. The cure list below is exact and minimal; cures 1–5 are one-to-few-line-class fixes, cure 6 is one ~30-line structural move that closes three confirmed defects at once. Spec amendments are marked where the spec itself authored the defect (§8.1 copy-count claim, §11 texture/tint clauses, §3 bbox-only gates).

cures.title: 1 · Invert the strike phase (the central conceit)
cures.detail: staffGeometry.ts:425 — emit strikePhase = frac((readingX − x) / period) (equivalently negate the delay in MusicStaff.vue:105). Probe-proven: shipped code fires every note at 1−φ instead of φ. Re-shape the gate to be direction-aware: for each motif note compute crossing time frac((x−readingX)/P) AND firing time from the emitted delay, assert equality — replacing the symmetric min(φ,1−φ)<0.1 check on the single parked note. Correct the story blurb only if the Verify seat confirms the lock in paint.

cures.title: 2 · Re-home progress ink + seal onto owned elements
cures.detail: styles.css:107/:125 write .glass-resting's ::after/::before, which grain-overlay.css (SOLE-writer declaration) and material.css (specular, inset:0) own — the progress ink paints at opacity 0.025 with overlay blend, the seal at ~0.07 at the LEFT edge (over-constrained box: surviving left:0 beats the declared inset-inline-end), and the loading folio loses its grain and rim. Move both features to two plain child divs inside .music-staff__window (or pseudos of a new inner .music-staff__paper wrapper carrying no glass class). Recommend minting the repo-level gate the design challenger proposed: no component stylesheet may declare ::before/::after on an element bearing a glass-* rung class.

cures.title: 3 · Anchor beams to stems
cures.detail: staffGeometry.ts:377/:384 anchor beams at run[..].x (head centre); stems live at x ± stemAttachX (0.57). Set x1/x2 to the first/last stem x plus a small overhang (~0.06 sp); evaluate beamY and member.tipY at each STEM x, not head x (kills the slope×0.57 vertical miss); anchor the lone-secondary stub (:374) on its own stem, stubbing into the group. Gate: every beamed stem satisfies stemX ∈ [x1−ε, x2+ε] and |beamY(stemX) − stem.y2| < ε, run over the demo study corpus (which currently emits j-b2 with x2 < x1 in violation of the suite's own x2 > x1 invariant — replace that invariant with the stem-join gate).

cures.title: 4 · Normalize glyph subpath winding
cures.detail: Probe-confirmed under fill-rule nonzero: ACCIDENTAL_SHARP and ACCIDENTAL_NATURAL stems wind CW (+0.28/+0.20) while their bars wind CCW (−0.31/−0.18) — winding 0, i.e. a punched hole, at every bar×stem crossing; F_CLEF ball (+1.01) cancels against its body (−3.64) — the white wedge visible in 10-zoom-bass-flat-flag.jpeg; the G_CLEF eye disc cancels to winding 0 at its own centre (the eye is paper). Reverse the counter-directed subpaths so every union glyph winds one direction (do NOT switch to evenodd — it punches the sharp's crossings by rule). Add winding gates the spec's bbox gates are blind to: point-in-path probes at the eye centre, ball centre, each bar×stem crossing, and one body point per glyph. Spec amendment §3: anchor gates must include interior winding, not extents only.

cures.title: 5 · Free the five public tokens
cures.detail: styles.css:4–11 declares --music-staff-space/-ink/-accent/-folio/-loop-duration on .music-staff itself, and :18 re-declares -ink for bare — an element declaration always beats an inherited ancestor value, so all five documented tokens are dead to the wrapper idiom the repo documents in Progress.vue and the story demonstrates (violet wrapper renders chebyshev blue, its blurb and aria-label both false). Cure: delete the on-element declarations; read each token at its consumption sites as var(--music-staff-x, <token default>) or via private --_music-staff-* consumption vars (per-material ink default selects the fallback, not the public token). Add a source-level gate asserting no declaration of the public tokens on .music-staff. Correct the two story claims (blurb line 100, aria-label line 108) only when the override demonstrably reaches paint.

cures.title: 6 · Staff furniture to window space (one move, three defects)
cures.detail: The five rules, initial barline, and reading line become full-width window-space layers on an owned child (the repeating-linear-gradient technique styles.css:112 already uses), and the SVG carries ink only. This simultaneously cures: the reel running dry above 1354 px (probe: guaranteed ink 169.3 sp vs 229.9 sp of drawn rules — up to 485 px of bare rules per cycle, cell 06 confirms; §8.1's fixed-copy-count 'any host width' claim is arithmetically impossible and needs the spec amendment), the 62 px empty/decorative staff reading as a render failure, and the ~31% folio fill (rules then always span the folio). Update the contract test's `.music-staff__reel > use` count assertion, which currently gates the defect in. Fallback if the furniture move is declined: cap loading-mode max-width at 3·P sp and give score/empty windows width: fit-content — lesser, and must be documented as a stated maximum.

cures.title: 7 · Sealed means stopped
cures.detail: styles.css:228 pauses only .music-staff__reel; the 14 note-strike animations keep running at data-sealed with one note frozen mid-accent, and MusicStaff.vue:82 emits aria-busy: true unconditionally so a completed progressbar announces busy at aria-valuenow=1. Pause/clear the strike animations under [data-sealed] (let colour settle to ink) and emit aria-busy only while unsealed. Add the contract assertions for both.

cures.title: 8 · Gutter the reel at the clef and the crop edges
cures.detail: Loading-mode ink streams over the parked clef (ink minimum 4.86 sp translating −56.1 sp across the clef zone 0.8–3.48; cell 03b catches a struck note on the clef) and both window edges crop glyphs mid-ink — .music-staff__clip-edge exists in score mode only. Clip the transport to x ≥ noteX0 − lead (one clipPath rect) or apply an inline-edge mask fade, both edges, loading mode.

cures.title: 9 · Material honesty (spec amendment §11)
cures.detail: The impl follows §11 verbatim, and §11 is wrong twice: background-image: var(--paper-clean-texture) duplicates the grain the ladder already paints at 0.025/200px tile — delete the component's full-opacity copy (§11's 'longhand beats the rung's shorthand' rationale misreads the rung: --glass-plate-tinted is a color-mix colour, the texture lives on the grain ::after); and --glass-tint-strength: 85% (resolved ~95.8% alpha) transmits ~4% backdrop against the ladder's documented ≤24% translucent floor — the folio asserts glass and paints paper, self-defeating §11's own adoption argument. Re-litigate with the owner: genuine glass folio (tint within the ladder's translucent range) or an honest opaque paper via the ladder's opaque escape — not the current middle.

cures.title: 10 · Verify-seat follow-ups post-cure (browser required, not blocking the cures)
cures.detail: (a) Whether <use> clones tick the strike animation — under-determined from disk (frozen frames legitimately show zero strikes ~33% of the time under the sign bug); if clones do not animate, render real copies of the ink layer instead of <use>. (b) Whether the spec-intended twin-flash under duplication (all visible copies of a note flash on its beat — §8.5 blesses this) reads as rhythm or as noise; the design challenger's stationary clip-band accent at the reading line is the alternative if the owner rules against twins. (c) Reading-line prominence: 0.1 sp at opacity 0.62 loses to the 0.13 sp rules it crosses — the central conceit is the faintest mark on the surface. (d) Strike scope: stems/beams/flags are siblings of .music-staff__note, so a struck head flashes accent on an ink stem; likewise note-land scales the group INCLUDING ledger lines (staff furniture should not scale). Minor register for the same pass: stemAttachX 0.53 (= headHalfWidth − stemThickness/2) vs shipped 0.57; head-ellipse literals duplicated between template and METRICS; GLYPH_EXTENT.fClef.x1 folds the dots in while gClef.x1 is path-only (two meanings in one table); clef prop forwarded to the loading motif engraves 14/14 ledgered notes in bass (probe-confirmed nonsense combination — warn in DEV per the Progress precedent); replay() remounts via rAF without the spec's <Transition>; both loaders run in golden-delay lockstep.
